schema.scenario_scope: Only388 admitted original case objects. The2held case objects remain in the copied original51cohort, linked from their8 supplementary rows.
schema.metric_scope: Artifact utility is not semantic utility. Different primary definitions are not combined into one ASR. D/E extra evidence does not add episode rows.

reproduction.scope: Reproduce the portable table index from unchanged source tables; no model/native execution or score recomputation.
